description: Source code for importing dashboards and slices in Superset, including functions for importing charts, dashboards, and related utilities, as well as a command class for batch importing dashboards from JSON files.

classes.name: ImportDashboardsCommand
classes.description: Command class for importing dashboards from JSON files in batch.

methods.name: import_chart

methods.name: import_dashboard

methods.name: decode_dashboards
methods.description: Recreates dashboard-related objects from JSON representation during import.

methods.name: import_dashboards
methods.description: Main function to import dashboards and associated datasources from JSON content.
